metadata.description: jevmate: a fast decision layer for coding agents

plugins.name: jevmate
plugins.description: A fast decision layer for coding agents: Jev ranks files, picks tests, sorts failures and reviews diffs, and keeps what the work needs through a compaction, so the expensive model reads only what matters. Measured thresholds.

plugins.name: context-kernel
plugins.description: Durable context for coding agents that tracks when earlier advice goes stale. It keeps what you tell the agent and what your decision records say, notices when you change your mind, and flags a recommendation for review when a fact it rested on changes. Local SQLite, judged by jev on a local model (install jevmate too).
